title: Derivatization-assisted dual-mode colorimetric and fluorometric detection of dopamine using 4-hexyl resorcinol
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25902-25911
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02276F, Paper

Mohamed N. Goda, Laila S. Alqarni, Faisal K. Algethami, Hossieny Ibrahim, Al-Montaser Bellah H. Ali, Ramadan Ali, Mohamed M. El-Wekil
A derivatization-based dual-mode sensing strategy was developed for DA determination via oxidative coupling with 4-HRS, producing highly emissive azamonardine for sensitive colorimetric and fluorescence detection.
